open.title: TOP PRIORITY founder step: Apify config + 0600 credential unlocks 3 tested Actors
open.detail: Three Actors are ready and unlisted: rss-reader (22/22 offline tests), link-checker (21/21) and domain-availability (22/22, RDAP-only, no contact data; built 2026-11-04, products/actors/domain-availability/core-test-results.json). Apify is the only channel with built-in pay-per-event billing. Missing: a valid enabled Apify config and a private credential file with mode 0600. Afterwards: a private PUBLISH_ACTOR of each, one real run, an independent APPROVE of each exact digest, then listing. Kill any Actor with fewer than 3 external users within 14 days. Demand and revenue are unverified.
open.expected_gain: First path to verifiable pay-per-event charges. Incumbents showed 29-53 users_30d; our revenue is unverified.

open.title: No founder-authorized participant identity for bounties, prize challenges or job boards
open.detail: Updated 2026-11-06. Several bounded tests found the same prerequisite. First, Expensify bounties need an accepted proposal, Upwork hiring and a CLA (products/research/public-bounty-opportunity.json). Second, translation job boards need registered accounts (technical-translation-request-test.json). Third, DrivenData GEMS (DOE, $300,000 advertised) requires a named competitor who registers and certifies eligibility under penalty of perjury (products/services/sponsored-challenge/rejection.json, TASK-179395596113). Agents will not create accounts, accept rules or make certifications. Founder step, only if desired: designate a participant identity and approve one specific challenge's rules. Until then, these channels are parked and no further scans are planned.
open.expected_gain: Would allow consideration of sponsor-funded prizes and bounties; no award or payout is guaranteed and advertised prizes are not verified funding.

open.title: Interac CAD route exists but is operator-only; first order needs a real request plus operator create/accept
open.detail: Updated 2026-11-07. The host shows order_payments READY_FOR_INSTRUCTIONS (INTERAC, CAD). docs/INTERAC-COMMANDES.md (TASK-179408556112) says order creation and acceptance are administrative through orders_admin.py, and deposits need founder attestation. Agents cannot accept orders. A ready handoff is in products/services/payment-handoff/operator-instructions.md: terms v1 for the welfare follow-on brief at CAD 49, terms_sha256 8da570ec..., the exact create/accept/confirm/allocate/post sequence and an acceptance check. Founder/operator step, only when a real eligible request arrives: create and accept the order, then confirm the observed deposit. No eligible request has been observed; order counts are UNAVAILABLE. Apify option A (NO-APIFY-ACCESS) is still a separate credential dependency.
open.expected_gain: A paid email service request can be settled in CAD and posted as founder-attested revenue. No demand or revenue is established.

open.title: No founder-approved community account for replying to public requests we have already answered
open.detail: Observed 2026-11-08: the Ghost import diagnostic is ONLINE_VERIFIED (TASK-179413056111) and answers the public forum thread t/60053. We have no authorized account to reply there, so the asker can only find it through organic search (lesson L107). outgoing_acquisition is NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Possible founder step, only if wanted: designate one dedicated GlobalLand account on one named community forum and approve posting rules (AI disclosure, replies only to public questions we have answered, no unsolicited direct messages, no price in replies unless forum rules allow). Agents will not create accounts or post without that approval. Only direct thread replies depend on this. Organic exposure, inbound private mail intake and Interac settlement of a real request remain independent. Reconsider if an account is approved or a classified inbound request arrives.
open.expected_gain: Would put answers to stated problems in front of the people who asked. This is not demand, orders or revenue.

open.title: Public mail counters cannot distinguish normal skips or unclassified sources from an observation gap
open.detail: Observed 2026-11-07: the last private cycle had processed 0 and skipped 5, and commercial feedback had 3 unclassified sources and 2 excluded sources. The public docs list possible reasons, but no public counter maps to them (products/services/inbound-routing/observability-result.json). Host-operator technical handoff: add fixed-enum, count-only reason fields to the public projection. These are skipped_{loop_excluded, armor_or_analysis_deferred, already_seen, budget_deferred} and unclassified_{legacy_ready, interpretation_pending, malformed}. They would carry no ids, addresses or bodies, which AGENTMAIL.md:35 permits. Optionally, the operator could also attest the AGENTMAIL.md:42 real benign-mail test. Agents cannot change host code. Dependent effect: the 19 and 20 Nov experiment verdicts must report requests as UNKNOWN. Reconsider when the breakdown appears, a classified count changes or the operator attests the test.
open.expected_gain: Lets the live experiments tell 'no inbound requests' apart from 'requests not observed'. No demand or revenue is implied.
